title: kalanchoe uniflora
intro: Kalanchoe uniflora, commonly known as the Red Pancake Plant or Fire and Ice Plant, is a species of succulent plant belonging to the family Crassulaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Kalanchoe uniflora include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-proliferative effects. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
